mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking_order ( id, order_no, request_no, user_id, trip_id, seat_number, price_snapshot, status, expires_at, payment_no, paid_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderNo}, #{requestNo}, #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{seatNumber}, #{priceSnapshot}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{paymentNo}, #{paidAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, request_no, user_id, trip_id, seat_number, price_snapshot, status, expires_at, payment_no, paid_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM booking_order WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_no, request_no, user_id, trip_id, seat_number, price_snapshot, status, expires_at, payment_no, paid_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM booking_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_no, request_no, user_id, trip_id, seat_number, price_snapshot, status, expires_at, payment_no, paid_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM booking_order WHERE request_no = #{requestNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_no, request_no, user_id, trip_id, seat_number, price_snapshot, status, expires_at, payment_no, paid_at, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, version, created_at, updated_at FROM booking_order WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND expires_at <= #{expiredAt} ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
